description: Capabilities for the main SecuraCV Lab window: exactly what its pages call. core.invoke of the app's own commands needs no core grant; core:event:default is for the flash, serial and update:log listeners; opener:default is for the links lab-nav.js hands to the OS browser. No core:default, so none of its tray, menu, window or webview permissions reach the webview (the tray and the menu are driven from Rust only; see desktop.json).
